description: List the coins and chains you can pay an OpenRouter (Coinbase) invoice with through Rozo: USDC/USDT, native coins and BTC over Lightning, with token decimals. Static list, no network call; quote_invoice tells which native coins a given invoice accepts. Native coins (ETH on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum; BNB on BNB Chain; POL on Polygon; SOL on Solana) are exact-out like Lightning: the order states the exact coin amount, priced at the current rate plus an FX spread on top of the service fee, and that price holds only until quoteExpiresAt. Native orders are capped at $2000 per invoice (native ETH on Ethereum needs at least $1), and a native coin is offered only when quote_invoice lists it for that invoice. ZEC on Zcash (Beta) is not available through this server: send a payer holding ZEC to https://checkout.rozo.ai/zec.
name: supported_coins
